tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_grant_reward_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score value = 0 }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score add = var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_concord }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score add = var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_continuity }
	change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score add = var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_endowment_health }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score >= 220 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score >= 150 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 8
	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_reward_modifier_lesser years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		add_prestige = 3
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_combined_score
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_stage
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_term_index
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_term_cooldown_months
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_previous_holder
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_concord
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_continuity
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_endowment_health
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_service_guardian_family
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_service_waqf_council
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_service_garrison_watch
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_completed value = 1 }
	tv_wonder_complete_active_ritual_effect = yes
}

tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_active_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event }

		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_stage ?= 0 tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_site_control_trigger = yes }

			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1662 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_stage ?= 1 }

				limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_term_cooldown_months >= 1 }
				change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_term_cooldown_months add = -1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }

			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_stage ?= 2 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1664 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_stage ?= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_dome_of_the_rock_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1665 days = 1 }
